extracted.name: Beer Cheese Pretzel Dip
extracted.description: Cheesy ranch dressing dip with the zing of beer is a great go-with for pretzels or cut-up veggies. All you do is mix it up and chill.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) package dry ranch salad dressing mix
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mash the cream cheese with the ranch dressing mix until thoroughly combined, then stir in the Cheddar cheese. Mix in beer, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach the desired consistency (add more for a thinner dip). Stir in the seasoned salt and cayenne pepper. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 1 hour.
